Question: Which evidence best supports the idea that atoms contain electrons?

answer.text: Cathode rays behaved as negatively charged particles.

feedback.text: Cathode ray deflection supported negatively charged electrons.
Color change is not the evidence for electrons.

answer.text: Atoms always have the same mass.

feedback.text: Same mass is not true for all atoms or isotopes.
Radio waves are electromagnetic radiation, not direct electron evidence.
